stem: ![](asset:P000034-stem-1) The graph shows the variation of displacement of a particle executing S.H.M. with time. We infer from this graph that

options.A: The force is zero at time $\frac{3T}{4}$
options.B: The velocity is maximum at time $\frac{T}{2}$
options.C: The acceleration is maximum at time $T$
options.D: The P.E. is equal to total energy at time $\frac{T}{2}$

assets.alt: Displacement y against time t: a sine curve starting at zero, reaching its maximum at T/4, zero at T/2, its minimum at 3T/4 and zero again at T.
